Retain natural upper-jaw length; do not squash the region between eyes, nose and mouth. Do not enlarge the whole face or shove the eye/mouth group sideways. The resulting facial front must face the same direction as the already-posed skull. Preserve all hair over the face as foreground occlusion in its existing positions.

Use the neutral identity only for facial appearance and line quality, not to reset pose. Maintain the existing detailed silver-lavender-haired blue-eyed character, clean anime illustration and white background.
